title: fix(plugin-list): name the icon-only Filter, Export and Add record toolbar buttons
body:
Fixes #12500
Clause-②: no

## What changed

Below the `sm` breakpoint the list toolbar's Filter, Export and Add record buttons render icon-only: their only label was a `hidden sm:inline` span. Each now carries an `aria-label` from the same i18n key as its visible label, so the accessible name is the same words at every width.

- Filter (`toolbar-filter-trigger`): `list.filter`, or, with filters active, the new `list.filterActive` ("Filter, {{count}} active"). The `aria-label` replaces the count badge in the name, so the count rides on the key.
- Export (wide form only): `list.export`.
- Add record, top and bottom (`add-record-button`): `list.addRecord`.
- `list.filterActive` is an i18next count family in all ten packs, with every CLDR slot each language selects (es, fr, pt, ru and ar inflect the adjective). The plugin-list `LIST_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` table carries the en rows, like `list.recordCount`.
- Every `data-testid` is unchanged.

The Studio Data pillar's Records toolbar is the same component: `StudioDesignSurface` renders `ListView` from `@object-ui/plugin-list` in the plugin ObjectView's `renderListView` slot. This fix covers both surfaces (checked by reading the code, not in a browser).

## Pins

New test: `ListView.toolbarAccessibleNames-12500.test.tsx`. It reproduces the narrow toolbar by mounting the one Tailwind rule that applies below `sm` (`.hidden { display: none }`) without the `sm:inline` rule that undoes it.

- Below sm: `getByRole('button', { name: 'Filter' })` finds the Filter trigger. Both toolbar Add record buttons are found by name `Add record`.
- Below sm, non-compact toolbar: `getByRole('button', { name: 'Export' })` finds Export.
- Below sm, one active filter: the Filter trigger's accessible name is `Filter, 1 active`.
- CONTROL, wide (no rule mounted): each button's text is exactly its label, and its accessible name is that label once (`Filter`, not `Filter Filter`).

Ablation, run after the fix was committed. `ListView.tsx` was restored to the branch base (`a90c131`), which left 0 fix markers on disk. Result: **3 failed, 1 passed** (the control). On the branch base, the active-filter case read the accessible name `1`, the bare count the card reports. Restored with `git checkout HEAD`: `git diff HEAD` is empty and the blob hash matches HEAD.

`ListView.fieldListRead-11984.test.tsx` keys each toolbar popover by its trigger's name and already dropped a count badge's digits. While a filter is held, the Filter name is now `Filter, 1 active`, so that sweep also drops the text after the comma. Its four cases are green.

## Verification (final tree `260589c`)

- Dependency closure build (`--filter '@object-ui/plugin-list^...' --filter '@object-ui/i18n^...'`): exit 0.
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/plugin-list` and `@object-ui/i18n` (both scripts echoed): exit 0.
- `vitest run packages/plugin-list/ packages/i18n/`: 219 files passed, 2763 tests passed, 13 skipped.
- The pre-tsc battery named in the dispatch, plus `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major` and `check-new-cross-file-line-citations`: all exit 0. `check:spec-floors` exits 1, as it does on main; recorded, not touched.
- ESLint on the 13 changed source/test files (`--format json`): 0 errors. The warnings are the file's existing `no-explicit-any` and React-hooks warnings, plus two `any` in the new test's data-source double. The full-repo `pnpm lint` is left to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- The ar and ru `list.filterActive` slots are agent translations of a short phrase. A native reader may want to review the adjective agreement.
- `list.filterActive` is a count family rather than a single key, because `count-families-11445` requires one for a `{{count}}` leaf that a word agrees with. It is still the one new key the ruling asked for.
